main_measure.name: mean excess gain of (forecast/10) x 5-bar excess return on grid cases

statistic.name: t of the mean, same-day cases summed

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passed; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: upper minus lower |forecast| half, mean short-direction 5-bar excess return (Welch t >= 1)

decided_by: The t of the mean excess gain lies between -2 and 2, which the plan calls inconclusive.
reading: The upper half is |forecast| strictly above the median and the lower half at or below it, the coin's mean 5-bar return is taken on the same non-overlapping grid of all its windows, the day-clustered t uses a G/(G-1) correction, and the supporting check's value is its Welch t (upper minus lower).
